title: COPB2 promotes hepatocellular carcinoma progression through regulation of YAP1 nuclear translocation.
authors: Wu, Biao; Guo, Xianlin; Wu, Zhishi; Chen, Liang; Zhang, Suqing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究COPB2调控YAP1核转位促进肝癌进展，属于临床肿瘤学与细胞信号通路研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟建模内容，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Although Yes-associated protein 1 (YAP1) is an important oncogene in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) progression, its nuclear localization prevents it from being considered a potential therapeutic target. Recently, studies have reported that coatomer protein complex subunit beta 2 (COPB2) also plays a critical role in HCC development; however its mechanism of action is unclear. This study aimed to investigate the role of COPB2 and YAP1 in the progression of HCC and to elucidate the underlying mechanisms. METHODS: COPB2 and YAP1 expression in HCC tissues were first analyzed by database searches and immunohistochemistry. Nomogram and artificial neural network models were established based on COPB2 and YAP1 expression. Cell proliferation was detected by cell counting kit-8 and clone formation assay, while cell migration and invasion were assessed using Transwell assays. Finally, the potential mechanisms underlying COPB2 regulation of YAP1 nuclear translocation were explored by immunofluorescence assay and Western blot. RESULTS: COPB2 combined with YAP1 expression was associated with overall postoperative survival in HCC patients and was an independent prognostic factor. High expression of both COPB2 and YAP1 in patients may reduce the efficacy of postoperative transarterial chemoembolization therapy. In vitro experiments revealed that COPB2 affected the sensitivity of HCC cells to Cisplatin (DDP) by regulating YAP1 nuclear translocation. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings suggest that COPB2/YAP1 affects the drug sensitivity of HCC cells to DDP and that targeting COPB2/YAP1 may be a promising strategy for the precision treatment of HCC.
abstract_zh: 目的：尽管Yes相关蛋白1（YAP1）在肝细胞癌（HCC）进展中是一个重要的癌基因，但其核定位使其不被视为潜在的治疗靶点。近期研究报道，外壳蛋白复合物亚基β2（COPB2）在HCC发展中也发挥关键作用，但其作用机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在探讨COPB2和YAP1在HCC进展中的作用，并阐明其潜在机制。方法：首先通过数据库检索和免疫组织化学分析HCC组织中COPB2和YAP1的表达。基于COPB2和YAP1表达建立列线图和人工神经网络模型。通过细胞计数试剂盒-8和克隆形成实验检测细胞增殖，而细胞迁移和侵袭则使用Transwell实验评估。最后，通过免疫荧光实验和Western blot探讨COPB2调控YAP1核转位的潜在机制。结果：COBP2与YAP1联合表达与HCC患者术后总生存率相关，并且是独立的预后因素。患者中COPB2和YAP1的高表达可能降低术后经动脉化疗栓塞治疗的效果。体外实验揭示，COPB2通过调控YAP1核转位影响HCC细胞对顺铂（DDP）的敏感性。结论：我们的发现表明，COPB2/YAP1影响HCC细胞对DDP的药物敏感性，靶向COPB2/YAP1可能是HCC精准治疗的一个有前景的策略。
